spots.bio: A walk at Murray Lagoon for swamp birdlife including ducks, swans and waders.
spots.name: Timber Creek Walk (Cape Gantheaume)
spots.note: Kept: Agency-sourced walk at Murray Lagoon in Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park for swamp birdlife (ducks, swans, waders); named walk. Seasonal flooding in winter. Overlaps the Bald Hill/Curley Creek area b Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A long walk along the edge of Murray Lagoon with birdlife and native vegetation.
spots.name: Curley Creek Hike (Cape Gantheaume)
spots.note: Kept: Agency-sourced hike along Murray Lagoon edge in Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park (6 km from park office) with birdlife and vegetation; named long walk, distinct from Bald Hill walk. Winter flooding. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A walk to a lookout above Tadpole Cove past early-settler threshing floor and cottage ruins, with ospreys to watch.
spots.name: Tadpole Cove Walk (Cape Gantheaume)
spots.note: Kept: Agency-sourced walk (DEW/NPWS) to a lookout above Tadpole Cove past early-settler threshing floor and cottage ruins; osprey watching. Distinct named walk. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: Surf and fishing beaches on the south coast, popular with surfers.
spots.name: D'Estrees Bay
spots.note: Kept: Two counted sources: surf and fishing beaches with south coast scenery, a favourite of surfers. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A lagoon with koalas, a bird hide and a walking trail to old eucalyptus distillery ruins and a picnic area.
spots.name: Duck Lagoon
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board and Wikivoyage name it: koalas, bird hide, walking trail around the lagoon to old eucalyptus distillery ruins and picnic area. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A small museum on the edge of Parndana about the soldier settlement scheme.
spots.name: Parndana Soldier Settlement Museum
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board names this small historical display on the soldier settlement scheme on the edge of Parndana; open museum, about 30 min. Objection: small, one-source museum. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A calm river near Vivonne Bay for swimming and kayaking, with koalas and echidnas to spot.
spots.name: Harriet River
spots.note: Kept: Board names the calm river near Vivonne Bay for swimming and kayaking with koala and echidna spotting; distinct from the beach. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A headland west of Vivonne Bay with coastal scenery, Southern Ocean waves and rock pools to swim in.
spots.name: Point Ellen
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board names the Vivonne Bay western headland for coastal scenery, crashing Southern Ocean waves and turquoise rock pools to swim in (swell warning). Second-tier headland a guide names. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A Southern Ocean beach where visitors walk the dunes to three beaches.
spots.name: Hanson Bay
spots.note: Kept: Two counted sources: board says watch the Southern Ocean roll in and beach-walk the dunes to three beaches. (Candidate coordinates are a NZ Hanson Bay: wrong, resolve afresh.) Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: The island's westernmost inlet at the Rocky River mouth, with sea views and wildlife.
spots.name: West Bay
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board singles out West Bay as the island's westernmost inlet at the Rocky River mouth, with sea views and wildlife; a bay a guide names. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A beach and campground beneath cliffs at the Western River mouth, habitat of the glossy black cockatoo.
spots.name: Western River Cove
spots.note: Kept: Tourism board and Wikivoyage name it: beach and campground beneath cliffs at the Western River mouth, glossy black cockatoo habitat. Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.

spots.bio: A wilderness protection area beside Cape Borda with a hiking trail through the Valley of the Cassowaries.
spots.wiki: Ravine des Casoars Wilderness Protection Area
spots.name: Ravine des Casoars
spots.note: Kept: Wilderness protection area beside Cape Borda that the board names for exploring the Valley of the Cassowaries (hiking trail). Placed inside Kangaroo Island, reached from the island's bases; no other destination exists nearby.
